newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-INJURED CONTE UNLIKELY TO NEED SURGERY, SAY JUVENTUS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-INJURED CONTE UNLIKELY TO NEED SURGERY, SAY JUVENTUS.

text.p: Midfielder Antonio Conte is unlikely to need surgery for a knee injury and could be playing again in six weeks, European Cup holders Juventus said on Monday.

Conte, the Juventus captain, faced the prospect of surgery and up to six months out of soccer after straining cruciate ligaments in his left knee during Italy's 1-0 World Cup qualifying win over Georgia earlier this month.
Juventus said tests had confirmed that an operation would not be needed unless complications arose. Club doctors plan to continue a programme of physiotherapy.
